name: retold-npm-proxy
description: Command-line control for the Retold local npm registry / pull-through cache: start, stop, status, warehouse, and publish private packages into it (via a direct tarball PUT, so package.json private:true stays intact).
author: steven@velozo.com
//deps: Just the pict CLI stack -- this tool drives the registry folder's own npm/docker scripts and talks to Verdaccio over HTTP, so it needs no web-server or registry code of its own.
